senses.gloss:
स्फीत, अस्, आ, अम्, swollen, enlarged, bulky, fat,
big, large, thick; much, abundant, many, numerous;
successful, prosperous; affected by hereditary disease.
—स्फीत-ता, f. bulkiness, enlargement; prosperity,
successful progress.
—स्फीती-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति,
&c., to enlarge, augment.
स्फीति, इस्, f. increase, enlargement; prosperity.

स्फिच् स्फिच्, क्, f. (by some connected with
rt. स्फाय्, ‘to be fat’), a buttock, hip; (औ), f. du.
the buttocks; [cf. Old Germ. spech; Angl. Sax.
spic.]
—स्फिक्-घातनक, अस्, m. a particular plant
or small tree much used in medicine (= कट्-फल,
p. 196, col. 1).

स्फिगी, f., Ved. the buttock, hip; (this form
स्फिगी seems necessary to account for स्फिग्या =
कट्या, Ṛg-veda III. 32, 11; स्फिग्यम् = कटि-
प्रदेशम्, Ṛg-veda VIII. 4, 8.)

स्फिट् स्फिट्, cl. 10. P. स्फेटयति, &c.,
to hurt, injure, kill (= rt. स्फिट्ट्); to
despise; to love (according to some); to cover (ac-
cording to some).

स्फिट्ट् स्फिट्ट्, cl. 10. P. स्फिट्टयति, &c.,
to hurt, kill (= rts. स्फिट्, स्फट्).
